data.name: FirstRunText
data.value: Itmam suggests Arabic words as you type. It runs in the notification area: right-click its icon for settings.

data.name: StartWithWindowsHint
data.value: You can also turn this off in Windows Settings → Apps → Startup.

data.name: AddSpace
data.value: Add a space after accepting a suggestion

data.name: MinUses
data.value: Uses before a new word is suggested

data.name: AboutTagline
data.value: Arabic word suggestions as you type, on the physical keyboard.

data.name: AboutPrivacy
data.value: Nothing you type leaves this device. Its only connection is asking Microsoft Store about updates, and it can be turned off.

data.name: ExitHint
data.value: Itmam closes completely until your next sign-in or until you start it yourself. To stop suggestions for a while only, use "Turn off Itmam" above.

data.name: AboutOpenSource
data.value: Itmam is free and open source under the MIT license.

data.name: ThemeLabel
data.value: Theme of the bar and this window

data.name: BarBackgroundHint
data.value: Automatic follows the theme, like the Windows suggestion bar.

data.name: BarHighlightHint
data.value: For the first suggestion, and when you choose with the arrow keys. Automatic uses your Windows accent color.

data.name: BarTextHint
data.value: Automatic picks the most readable color for the bar.

data.value: Small numbers for the shortcut that accepts suggestion 1, 2, 3…

data.name: ResetLookHint
data.value: Theme, colors, opacity and text size go back to the defaults.

data.name: ShortcutsIntro
data.value: Click a shortcut, then press the new keys. Click elsewhere to cancel.

data.name: ShortcutAcceptNthHint
data.value: This key held with the suggestion's number.

data.name: ShortcutDismissHint

data.name: NativeNavigationHint
data.value: ↑ moves into the bar, ← → choose, Enter inserts, Esc or ↓ leaves. Ctrl+Delete forgets the chosen learned word.

data.name: ResetShortcutsHint
data.value: Tab to insert, Esc to hide, Ctrl+Alt (pressed and released) to turn on or off, the arrow keys to choose, and Ctrl+Shift+Space for the long phrases list.

data.name: ExcludedIntro
data.value: Itmam stays completely silent in these apps: no suggestions, no learning, nothing read.

data.name: AddAppHint
data.value: Choose an open app, or browse for its program file.

data.name: ResetExcludedHint
data.value: Remote desktops, virtual machines, terminals and game launchers.

data.value: Exclude {0}? Itmam will stay completely silent in it: no suggestions and no learning.

data.value: Remove {0} from the excluded apps? Itmam will suggest and learn words in it again.

data.name: ConfirmResetExcluded
data.value: Restore the default list? Apps you added will be removed from it, and removed default apps will be excluded again.

data.name: WordsIntro
data.value: Words Itmam learned from you. Only the word, how many times you used it and when are kept, on this device.

data.name: AddWordHint
data.value: Added words are suggested at once. Blocked words are never suggested, even from the dictionary.

data.name: BlockWordPrompt
data.value: Type the word that should never be suggested:

data.name: EditWordPrompt
data.value: Correct the spelling (its uses are kept):

data.value: Type one Arabic word, without spaces.

data.name: ImportExportHint
data.value: A text file with one word per line, to back up your words or move them to another PC.

data.name: FileError
data.value: The file could not be read or written.

data.name: ConfirmDeleteWord
data.value: Delete {0}? It can be learned again if you use it.

data.value: Deletes every learned, added and blocked word from this device. This cannot be undone.

data.name: ConfirmClearWords
data.value: Delete all your words? This cannot be undone. Export them first if you want a copy.

data.value: Unblock {0}? It can be suggested again.

data.value: Click to open it in Microsoft Store.

data.name: ConfirmExit
data.value: Exit Itmam? Suggestions stop until you start it again or sign in next time. To stop them for a while, turn it off instead ({0}).

data.value: Notify when Itmam is turned off or on

data.value: Also when a one-hour pause ends.

data.value: Check for updates when Itmam starts

data.value: Itmam asks Microsoft Store through Windows. Nothing about you or what you type is sent.

data.name: UpdateAvailable

data.name: UpdateUnavailable
data.value: Updates come from Microsoft Store: this copy was not installed from it, or the Store could not be reached.

data.name: PhrasesIntro
data.value: {0} common phrases are built in: greetings, remembrance, prayers, occasions and formal letters. Type the start of one and Tab inserts it whole, or keep going word by word.

data.name: SuggestPhrasesHint
data.value: After «بسم » the bar offers «الله الرحمن الرحيم». Suggested: My phrases, the phrases learned from your typing, and the built-in list.

data.name: AddPhraseHint
data.value: Your signature, your organization's name, or any phrase you write often. Suggested before the built-in ones.

data.name: PhrasePrompt
data.value: Type the phrase (two Arabic words or more):

data.name: NotAPhrase
data.value: Type two Arabic words or more, without digits or Latin letters.

data.value: Words you type in a row twice (2 to 5 words) are suggested as a phrase. Kept on this device only; nothing is learned in password fields, excluded apps or while learning is paused. Sequences not repeated are deleted after 30 days.

data.name: NoLearnedPhrases
data.value: No learned phrases yet. Type the same words in a row twice and they appear here.

data.name: ConfirmForgetPhrase
data.value: Delete «{0}» from the learned phrases? It is learned again if you keep typing it.

data.name: ClearPhrasesHint
data.value: Deletes every learned phrase and every sequence counted so far from this device. My phrases are kept.

data.name: ConfirmClearPhrases
data.value: Delete all learned phrases? This cannot be undone.

data.name: LearnNewWordsHint
data.value: When off, nothing new is learned (words or phrases); your words are still suggested.

data.name: TextShortcutsIntro
data.value: Type a short code and the bar offers its text first; Tab inserts it in place of the code. For example «ع1» → «السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته».

data.name: AddTextShortcutHint
data.value: A code of Arabic letters, digits allowed after the first letter, and the text it inserts.

data.name: NotATextShortcutKey
data.value: The shortcut must start with an Arabic letter and contain only Arabic letters and digits, without spaces.

data.name: NotATextShortcutText
data.value: Type the text the shortcut inserts.

data.value: The shortcut «{0}» already exists. Replace its text?

data.name: TurnOffHint
data.value: Itmam tracks nothing until you turn it on again, here, from the icon's menu or with {0}.

data.name: ImportExportListHint
data.value: A text file to back them up or move them to another PC. Importing adds to the list and keeps what you have.

data.name: ImportExportPhrasesHint
data.value: A text file with My phrases and the learned phrases, to back them up or move them to another PC. Importing adds to what you have.
